## Analysis by Restaurant

```{r analysis-by-restaurant}
q_rest <- "
SELECT
  r.restaurant_name                              AS Restaurant,
  r.city                                         AS City,
  r.state                                        AS State,
  COUNT(v.visit_id)                              AS TotalVisits,
  COUNT(DISTINCT v.customer_id)                  AS UniqueCustomers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.loyalty_member = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LoyaltyMembers,
  ROUND(SUM(v.food_bill + v.alcohol_bill), 2)    AS TotalRevenue
FROM restaurants r
LEFT JOIN visits v    ON r.restaurant_id = v.restaurant_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON v.customer_id   = c.customer_id
GROUP BY r.restaurant_id, r.restaurant_name, r.city, r.state
ORDER BY r.restaurant_name;
"
df_rest <- dbGetQuery(mydb, q_rest)

df_rest$TotalRevenue <- paste0("$", formatC(df_rest$TotalRevenue,
                                             format = "f", digits = 2,
                                             big.mark = ","))

colnames(df_rest) <- c("Restaurant", "City", "State",
                        "Total Visits", "Unique Customers",
                        "Loyalty Members", "Total Food & Alcohol")

kable(df_rest,
      caption  = "Restaurant Summary: Visits, Customers, and Revenue",
      align    = c("l","l","c","r","r","r","r"),
      booktabs = TRUE,
      linesep  = "") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "striped"),
                font_size = 9,
                stripe_color = "gray!10") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4472C4", color = "white") %>%
  landscape()
```

## Sales & Visit Analytics

```{r sales-analytics}
years_df <- dbGetQuery(mydb, "
  SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(visit_date) AS yr
  FROM visits
  ORDER BY yr DESC
  LIMIT 3")
top_years <- sort(years_df$yr)

q_sales <- sprintf("
SELECT
  r.restaurant_name                                                     AS Restaurant,
  YEAR(v.visit_date)                                                    AS Year,
  ROUND(SUM(v.food_bill * (1 - v.food_discount_pct) + v.alcohol_bill), 2) AS Revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(v.food_bill + v.alcohol_bill), 2)                           AS AvgPartySpend,
  ROUND(AVG(v.party_size), 1)                                           AS AvgPartySize
FROM visits v
JOIN restaurants r ON v.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id
WHERE YEAR(v.visit_date) IN (%s)
GROUP BY r.restaurant_name, YEAR(v.visit_date)
ORDER BY r.restaurant_name, Year;
", paste(top_years, collapse = ","))

df_sales <- dbGetQuery(mydb, q_sales)

df_wide <- df_sales %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols    = Restaurant,
              names_from  = Year,
              values_from = c(Revenue, AvgPartySpend, AvgPartySize),
              names_glue  = "{Year}_{.value}")

rev_cols <- grep("_Revenue$", colnames(df_wide), value = TRUE)
for (col in rev_cols) {
  df_wide[[col]] <- ifelse(
    is.na(df_wide[[col]]), "—",
    paste0("$", formatC(as.numeric(df_wide[[col]]), format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")))
}

spend_cols <- grep("_AvgPartySpend$", colnames(df_wide), value = TRUE)
for (col in spend_cols) {
  df_wide[[col]] <- ifelse(
    is.na(df_wide[[col]]), "—",
    paste0("$", formatC(as.numeric(df_wide[[col]]), format = "f", digits = 2)))
}

size_cols <- grep("_AvgPartySize$", colnames(df_wide), value = TRUE)
for (col in size_cols) {
  df_wide[[col]] <- ifelse(is.na(df_wide[[col]]), "—", as.character(df_wide[[col]]))
}

display_names <- colnames(df_wide)
display_names <- gsub("_Revenue$",       " Rev",       display_names)
display_names <- gsub("_AvgPartySpend$", " Avg Spend", display_names)
display_names <- gsub("_AvgPartySize$",  " Avg Sz",    display_names)
colnames(df_wide) <- display_names

n_years <- length(top_years)

kable(df_wide,
      caption  = paste("Sales and Visit Analytics for Years:",
                        paste(top_years, collapse = ", ")),
      booktabs = TRUE,
      align    = c("l", rep("r", ncol(df_wide) - 1)),
      linesep  = "") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "striped"),
                font_size    = 7,
                stripe_color = "gray!10") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4472C4", color = "white") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     setNames(rep(n_years, 3),
                               c("Revenue by Year",
                                 "Avg Party Spend by Year",
                                 "Avg Party Size by Year")))) %>%
  landscape()
```

## Trend by Month for Florida

```{r florida-trend, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4, fig.align='center', out.width='100%'}
years2_df <- dbGetQuery(mydb, "
  SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(visit_date) AS yr
  FROM visits v
  JOIN restaurants r ON v.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id
  WHERE r.state = 'FL'
  ORDER BY yr DESC
  LIMIT 2")
fl_years <- sort(years2_df$yr)

q_fl <- sprintf("
SELECT
  MONTH(v.visit_date)                             AS Month,
  YEAR(v.visit_date)                              AS Year,
  ROUND(SUM(v.food_bill + v.alcohol_bill), 2)     AS Revenue
FROM visits v
JOIN restaurants r ON v.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id
WHERE r.state = 'FL'
  AND YEAR(v.visit_date) IN (%s)
GROUP BY MONTH(v.visit_date), YEAR(v.visit_date)
ORDER BY Month, Year;
", paste(fl_years, collapse = ","))

df_fl    <- dbGetQuery(mydb, q_fl)

month_names <- month.abb[1:12]
avg_rev <- sapply(1:12, function(m) {
  vals <- df_fl$Revenue[df_fl$Month == m]
  if (length(vals) == 0) NA else mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
})

y_max   <- max(avg_rev, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.25
y_ticks <- pretty(c(0, y_max), n = 5)

par(mar = c(3.5, 4.5, 3.5, 1))

plot(1:12, avg_rev,
     type  = "b",
     pch   = 19,
     col   = "steelblue",
     lwd   = 2,
     xaxt  = "n",
     yaxt  = "n",
     xlab  = "Month",
     ylab  = "",
     main  = paste0("Florida Monthly Revenue  |  Avg of ",
                    fl_years[1], " & ", fl_years[2]),
     xlim  = c(1, 12),
     ylim  = c(0, y_max),
     cex.main = 0.95,
     cex.lab  = 0.85,
     font.main = 2)

mtext("Average Revenue ($)", side = 2, line = 3.5, cex = 0.85)

axis(1, at = 1:12, labels = month_names, cex.axis = 0.75, tcl = -0.3)

axis(2, at = y_ticks,
     labels = paste0("$", formatC(y_ticks / 1000, format = "d"), "K"),
     las = 1, cex.axis = 0.75, tcl = -0.3)

abline(h = y_ticks, lty = "dotted", col = "gray85")
abline(v = 1:12,    lty = "dotted", col = "gray85")

polygon(c(1:12, 12:1),
        c(avg_rev, rep(0, 12)),
        col    = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.10),
        border = NA)

# Data labels alternate above/below to avoid crowding
for (i in 1:12) {
  if (!is.na(avg_rev[i])) {
    pos_dir <- ifelse(i %% 2 == 1, 3, 1)
    text(i, avg_rev[i],
         labels = paste0("$", formatC(round(avg_rev[i] / 1000, 0),
                                       format = "d"), "K"),
         pos  = pos_dir,
         cex  = 0.62,
         col  = "steelblue4",
         font = 2)
  }
}

legend("topleft",
       legend = paste("Avg of", fl_years[1], "and", fl_years[2]),
       col    = "steelblue",
       lwd    = 2,
       pch    = 19,
       bty    = "n",
       cex    = 0.8)
```
